title: Synthetic token lifecycle and recurring agreements
topic: Synthetic token lifecycle and recurring agreements
applicability: Synthetic Synthetic token lifecycle and recurring agreements product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
Only the synthetic network-token product implements xp_c_network_cards and xp_c_network_tokens. replace_network_card changes PAN generation, records supported updater success and unsupported STALE results; it does not cancel merchant agreements. manage_merchant_token refresh can repair stale merchant credentials, but does not reinstate a cancelled recurring agreement. revoke_token leaves the agreement active and permits a new token at billing. cancel_agreement cancels the actual recurring obligation. run_merchant_billing processes one due invoice per merchant exactly once; stale/closed credentials fail, and cancelled agreements are skipped. Merchant importance is a customer preference. Source motif only: 05_simplest_75_to_100pct/view-world-card-info.sop.md — Card extension may retain the card number while expiry and CVV change; synthetic card replacement and network generation changes are separate. Source motif only: 04_simple_50_to_75pct/world-card-cancelled-deduction-failure.sop.md — Merchant-side cancellation remains necessary after card closure. Network-token behavior is newly synthetic.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_subscription_consents. manage_subscription_consent accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Retrieve pending merchant captures independently of token replacement. Void the unwanted capture, renew named service consents and bind each consent to the current card generation. Cancellation of a token alone does not clear a pending capture. retrieve_capture_orders publishes the old merchant capture. dispose_capture with amount_minor=0 voids that old capture; a positive amount leaves the original capture available. record_service_consent uses the merchant name and the consent ceiling in amount_minor; zero withdraws consent. A current invoice cannot use an absent or insufficient consent. bind_card_generation associates the consents with the actual current card. A retained old capture may still debit cash at billing even after its recurring agreement ends. Services may finish ready without processing this cycle; preserve the contract ceilings and active credentials. Permitted actions: retrieve_capture_orders, dispose_capture, record_service_consent, bind_card_generation. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `manage_merchant_token`

refresh provisions a token on the current card; revoke_token revokes a token but leaves its merchant agreement active; cancel_agreement terminates its recurring contract and revokes the token. An active agreement may reprovision a revoked token on the next billing cycle.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `refresh`, `revoke_token`, `cancel_agreement` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `manage_subscription_consent`

Retrieve pending merchant captures independently of token replacement. Void the unwanted capture, renew named service consents and bind each consent to the current card generation. Cancellation of a token alone does not clear a pending capture. Actions: retrieve_capture_orders, dispose_capture, record_service_consent, bind_card_generation. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `retrieve_capture_orders`, `dispose_capture`, `record_service_consent`, `bind_card_generation` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `replace_network_card`

Replace a card in the synthetic token network. Replacing the PAN increments its generation; supported tokens update, unsupported tokens become STALE. Merchant agreements are unaffected. Closing the card disables all future charging.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `network_card_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `replace`, `close` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `run_merchant_billing`

Process the next due recurring cycle once. Active agreements with revoked tokens may reprovision under their existing agreement; stale tokens fail. Cancelled agreements are skipped. Each merchant has one due invoice.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `network_card_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
